from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox, QTableWidgetItem
from pickle import dump, load
from random import randint
# -----------------------------------

def occ(ch):
    f1 = open("chaines.dat", "rb")
    occ = 0
    eof = False
    while not eof:
        try:
            e = load(f1)
            if e["id"] == ch:
                occ += 1
        except:
            eof = True
    f1.close()
    return occ

def verif():
    ok = True
    id = win.id.text()
    nom = win.nom.text()
    cat = win.cat.currentIndex()
    co = win.co.isChecked()
    cn = win.cn.isChecked()
    url = win.url.text()

    if len(id) != 5 or not id.isdigit() or occ(id) > 0:
        QMessageBox.warning(win, "eurrure", "id invalide ")
        ok = False
    elif nom == "":
        QMessageBox.warning(win, "eurrure", " nom  invalide ")
        ok = False
    elif cat == 0:
        QMessageBox.warning(win, "eurrure", "cat invalide ")
        ok = False
    elif co == False and cn == False:
        QMessageBox.warning(win, "eurrure", " claire  invalide ")
        ok = False
    elif url == "":
        QMessageBox.warning(win, "eurrure", " claire  invalide ")
        ok = False
    return ok

def affiche_code():
    f = open("codes.dat", "rb")
    eof = False
    i = 0
    win.table_code.setRowCount(0)
    while not eof:
        try:
            e = load(f)
            win.table_code.insertRow(i)
            win.table_code.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(e["id"]))
            win.table_code.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(e["code"]))
            win.table_code.setItem(i, 2, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["valide"])))
            i += 1
        except:
            eof = True
    f.close()

def affiche_crypte():
    f1 = open("chaines.dat", "rb")
    eof = False
    win.list_chaine.clear()
    while not eof:
        try:
            e = load(f1)
            if e["claire"] == "N":
                win.list_chaine.addItem(e["id"] + "#" + e["nom"])
        except:
            eof = True
    f1.close()

app = QApplication([])
win = loadUi("interface_live.ui")
win.show()
win.btn1.clicked.connect(ajout_chaine)

win.btn3.clicked.connect(affiche_crypte)
win.btn4.clicked.connect(miseajour_code)
win.btn5.clicked.connect(affiche_code)
app.exec_()
